effects.description:
(5 items) Casting a non-Ultimate Curative Runeform ability grants an effect for |cffffff6|r seconds to you, if affected, and affected allies based on how many Crux you had.

At |cffffff1|r Crux, grant a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff3618|r damage. At |cffffff2|r Crux, grant Minor Heroism, generating |cffffff1|r Ultimate every |cffffff1.5|r seconds. At |cffffff3|r Crux, grant Major Protection, reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
